items.title: Chubby Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: Monk, he taught me how to play bass.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Checking it out. Well I’ve been looking forward to this time to talk with you.

And the things that I read, they always mention of course that you were a stellar bass player, but that you always brought a great deal of energy to whatever you did. Have you always been a person with high energy? As a kid, were you one of those kids?
